2026-10-27.patch_summary: This patch prevents alloc_contig_range from undoing another isolation in the range when it fails, which can cause an offline device to spin indefinitely holding a hotplug lock. The problem occurs when alloc_contig_range overlaps a block going offline and isolates its own blocks, but fails due to EBUSY on CPU 1's blocks. This patch fixes this issue by returning directly from alloc_contig_frozen_range_noprof when isolation fails, rather than undoing the isolation over the whole range. The approach taken is to modify the logic in alloc_contig_frozen_range_noprof to handle the case where isolation fails and another caller has isolated blocks in the range.
